healing_philosophy: Static generation produces a first-pass cohort; healing converts BACKLOGGED types into PUBLISHED examples through targeted, evidence-driven sprints. Each healing sprint closes a specific class of blocker — fixture gap, output validator gap, constraint gap, or external dependency — rather than regenerating arbitrarily. The pipeline converges to full coverage by iteratively reducing the deferred count family-by-family, wave-by-wave, with explicit stop conditions and velocity tracking per sprint.

prioritization_formula.description: Score 1-10 per deferred type. Higher score = higher priority for next healing sprint. All four factors are required; the weighted sum is normalized to 1-10.

factors.description: Can a valid input fixture be created programmatically with existing infrastructure? Score: 10=programmatic_input already working for family; 7=minor new programmatic code needed; 4=new fixture strategy class needed (e.g. pair_fixture); 1=requires external asset (TSA authority, encrypted file, signed cert)

Does output_validator.py already handle the expected output format? Score: 10=format already validated (pdf, xlsx, docx, png, jpg, tiff); 7=format header-check exists but semantic check missing; 4=new format handler needed (doc, ofd, xls); 1=output is non-file (e.g. image extraction to multiple files with no defined output_path)

Are all NuGet and .NET dependencies resolvable? Score: 10=same package already in use; 7=sibling namespace in existing package; 4=new NuGet dep required but available on nuget.org; 1=dep download failed / missing transitive dep (epub, ocr, omr)

Based on prior repair loop outcomes for this family/pattern, what is LLM repair success rate? Score: 10=family has 3+ consecutive PASSes on similar pattern; 7=1-2 PASSes; 4=build-repair succeeded but runtime still flaky; 1=all prior LLM attempts failed or produced semantically wrong code

pdf_Optimizer.rationale: Programmatic PDF fixture proven; pdf header validated; same package; 1st PASS achieved in pilot-pdf-20260508-155520. REVIEWED state — just needs second consecutive PASS before PR.

pdf_Splitter.rationale: PR_READY state; programmatic PDF fixture proven; pdf header validated. Awaiting APPROVE_LIVE_PR only.

pdf_PdfAConverter.rationale: Programmatic PDF input easy; output is PDF/A (still a PDF file with %PDF- header) so validator passes basic check; dependency is same package; similar to Merger pattern but PDF/A compliance check not implemented. Needs PDF/A compliance validator extension.

pdf_PdfToImage.rationale: Programmatic PDF input; image output_validator already handles PNG/JPEG; same package; pattern is new but similar to existing PDF workflows.

pdf_Png.rationale: Same as PdfToImage — PNG output validated by existing image header check.

pdf_Jpeg.rationale: JPEG output validated by existing image header check.

pdf_Tiff.rationale: TIFF output validated by existing image header check.

pdf_XlsConverter.rationale: Programmatic PDF; XLS output not covered by existing xlsx validator (different format); requires xls binary header check.

pdf_DocConverter.rationale: Programmatic PDF; DOC output validation not implemented (binary format); DOC header check needed.

pdf_Html.rationale: HTML input requires different fixture strategy (HTML file creation, not PDF). HTML output validator exists. New input strategy class needed.

pdf_ImageExtractor.rationale: Programmatic PDF with embedded images needed as fixture; output is multiple image files — no defined output_path, needs new validator pattern.

pdf_PdfExtractor.rationale: Programmatic PDF; output format validation unclear — needs investigation.

pdf_TableGenerator.rationale: Table structure fixture needs programmatic construction; PDF output validated; similar package.

pdf_TocGenerator.rationale: TOC generation requires multi-section PDF fixture; PDF output validated.

pdf_FormEditor.rationale: Requires PDF with pre-existing form fields — programmatic form field creation is complex. Needs Aspose.Pdf.Forms API for fixture. PDF output validated.

pdf_FormExporter.rationale: Form fields PDF + data source output format both undefined.

pdf_FormImporter.rationale: Paired input (PDF + data source) strategy not yet designed.

pdf_Security.rationale: Encrypted PDF fixture and password management not implemented.

pdf_SelectField.rationale: Requires PDF with select form fields — complex fixture.

pdf_Signature.rationale: Digital certificate (.pfx) required — external asset dependency.

pdf_Timestamp.rationale: Timestamp authority server required — external network dependency.

pdf_Ofd.rationale: OFD is a Chinese standard format; no fixture, no validator. Specialized format knowledge required.

words_MailMerger.rationale: Template DOCX with named merge fields needs programmatic creation via DocumentBuilder; DOCX output validated; same package; similar to Watermarker pattern.

words_Processor.rationale: Type classification pending — likely similar to Converter/Replacer. Investigate first.

words_ReportBuilder.rationale: LINQ template + data source required — specialized fixture. DOCX output validated.

email_Converter.rationale: EML/MSG input fixture requires programmatic creation via Aspose.Email core API (MailMessage.Save); output format validation for MSG/EML/HTML not implemented; family has zero run history.

slides_Compress.rationale: PPTX fixture requires Aspose.Slides core API; output PPTX validation not implemented; family has zero run history; XML docs missing.

slides_Convert.rationale: PPTX fixture; PDF/image output validated; family has zero run history.

slides_Merger.rationale: Requires multi-PPTX fixture (pair strategy not yet implemented for Slides); PPTX output validation not implemented.

Wave_A.label: HEALABLE_LOW_RISK
criteria: Fixture strategy already proven for the family (programmatic_input working)
Output format already validated by output_validator.py
At least one prior PASS in the family's repair loop history
Wave_A.infrastructure_delta: None — reuses existing programmatic_pdf fixtures and output validators. Only requires: (1) expand allowed_types in pdf.yml, (2) add per_type_constraints entries in _PROGRAMMATIC_FIXTURE_GUIDANCE for new types, (3) add XLS binary header check to output_validator.py.

Wave_B.label: HEALABLE_MEDIUM_RISK
criteria: New fixture strategy or new input format needed, but achievable via existing core Aspose API
Output validator may need a new format handler (e.g. DOC binary header, PPTX zip validation)
Family may be in DISCOVERY_ONLY status requiring pilot launch first
Wave_B.infrastructure_delta: Requires one or more of: (a) pair_fixture strategy implementation for multi-file inputs; (b) new output_validator format handlers (DOC, PPTX, EML); (c) new family pilot launch (email, slides); (d) new _PROGRAMMATIC_FIXTURE_GUIDANCE entries (email, slides, html).

Wave_C.label: HEALABLE_HIGH_RISK
criteria: Fixture requires complex multi-step programmatic setup (form fields, LINQ templates, encrypted content)
May require new fixture type class in fixture_factory
Output format may be entirely new to the pipeline
Wave_C.infrastructure_delta: Requires: (a) form_fields_pdf fixture type in fixture_factory.py; (b) pair_fixture for Slides and FormImporter; (c) LINQ template fixture for ReportBuilder; (d) encrypted_pdf fixture type.

Wave_D.label: EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED
criteria: Requires external asset (digital certificate, timestamp authority, proprietary format files)
Unblocking requires human action outside the pipeline (procure cert, stand up TSA, acquire OFD sample)
Wave_D.sprint_velocity: 0 per sprint until external blocker resolved
Wave_D.infrastructure_delta: After external blocker resolved: pfx_fixture type for Signature; tsa_endpoint config for Timestamp; ofd_fixture and validator for Ofd.

rerun_scheduling.description: Rules governing when a BACKLOGGED type is eligible for automatic rerun in the next healing sprint.

trigger_conditions.condition: A new REQUIRED or FORBIDDEN constraint targeting this type or its pattern has been merged to packet_builder.py or the family YAML per_type_constraints block
trigger_conditions.rationale: Constraint injection is the primary proven fix for hallucination failures (Optimizer, TextExtractor). Adding a constraint makes the type immediately retriable.

trigger_conditions.condition: The blocking_taskcard for this type has been CLOSED_VERIFIED and the required fixture strategy is now implemented in fixture_factory.py or _PROGRAMMATIC_FIXTURE_GUIDANCE
trigger_conditions.rationale: Pair-fixture and template-fixture blockers directly gate words_MailMerger, words_Merger, words_Comparer.

trigger_conditions.condition: output_validator.py has been extended with a new format handler covering this type's output extension
trigger_conditions.rationale: Types blocked by PILOT_SCOPE_DEFERRED with 'output validation not yet implemented' become retriable once the validator is extended.

trigger_conditions.condition: The family YAML allowed_types list has been expanded to include this type's name
trigger_conditions.rationale: PDF has 21 WORKFLOW_ROOT types outside allowed_pilot_types. Expanding the list unblocks them directly.

trigger_conditions.condition: A family in DISCOVERY_ONLY status has had controlled_pilot_approved set to true and a new pilot run completed
trigger_conditions.rationale: Email and Slides are blocked by DISCOVERY_ONLY status. Pilot launch unblocks all types in those families simultaneously.

trigger_conditions.condition: A type in the same family using the same pattern (same fixture strategy, same output format) has PASSED in the most recent sprint
trigger_conditions.rationale: When PdfToImage passes, Png/Jpeg/Tiff become higher-confidence reruns because the same code pattern applies.

trigger_conditions.condition: A previously failing dependency download has been resolved (package available on nuget.org, transitive dep added to resolved-libs)
trigger_conditions.rationale: Applies to epub, ocr, omr, psd families with reflection blockers.

rerun_scheduling.healing_attempt_tracking: Each BACKLOGGED entry must carry a 'healing_attempts' array. Each attempt records: {attempt_number, sprint_id, run_id, trigger_used, result: PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, failure_stage, failure_classification, timestamp}. The array is append-only.
rerun_scheduling.max_healing_attempts_rationale: After 5 attempts with different constraints/fixtures, a type is reclassified to EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED or REQUIRES_MANUAL_INVESTIGATION and removed from automated rerun. Human review required.
rerun_scheduling.backoff_strategy: Linear: attempt 1 = next sprint, attempt 2 = next sprint, attempt 3 = skip 1 sprint, attempt 4 = skip 2 sprints, attempt 5 = skip 3 sprints. Backoff prevents noisy LLM flakiness from consuming sprint capacity.
rerun_scheduling.cooldown_after_fail: A type that fails 2 consecutive attempts for the same failure_classification must have a new T1/T3/T4 trigger before being scheduled again — prevents infinite rerun loops.

burndown_metrics.target_per_sprint_reduction_rationale: Wave_A has 8 types at ~85% success rate = ~7 healed per sprint. Subsequent sprints drawing from Wave_B reduce to 3-5. Conservative target of 7 for Sprint R6 (Wave_A only).

projected_full_coverage_sprints.wave_b_sprint: Sprint R7-R8 — 11 Wave_B types (target 7 healed across 2 sprints)
projected_full_coverage_sprints.wave_c_sprint: Sprint R9-R10 — 8 Wave_C types (target 3-4 healed across 2 sprints)
projected_full_coverage_sprints.wave_d_sprint: Sprint R11+ — 3 Wave_D types (externally blocked, no target date)
projected_full_coverage_sprints.projected_zero_backlog_sprint: Sprint R10 (non-externally-blocked types), Sprint R11+ (externally blocked types)

metric_fields_to_add.alert_threshold: velocity < 0.5 for 2 consecutive sprints triggers architecture review

metric_fields_to_add.definition: Breakdown of deferred_total into Wave_A / Wave_B / Wave_C / Wave_D buckets
metric_fields_to_add.alert_threshold: Wave_D count increases (types regressing from Wave_B to Wave_D is a red flag)

metric_fields_to_add.definition: Sum of all healing_attempts entries across all BACKLOGGED types
Count of types promoted from Wave_C to Wave_D due to hitting max_healing_attempts
metric_fields_to_add.alert_threshold: More than 2 types retired per sprint signals constraint/fixture system needs redesign
< 0.5 signals LLM model degradation or prompt drift

architectural_recommendations.rationale: The 21 PDF WORKFLOW_ROOT deferred types are all blocked solely by allowed_types filter. Expanding in wave order (A then B then C) unblocks them progressively without overwhelming the repair loop.

architectural_recommendations.title: Add per_type_constraints entries in _PROGRAMMATIC_FIXTURE_GUIDANCE for Wave_A types
architectural_recommendations.rationale: Image-output types (Png, Jpeg, Tiff, PdfToImage) share a pattern but differ from TextExtractor in output handling. A dedicated PROGRAMMATIC_FIXTURE_GUIDANCE entry prevents LLM hallucination of wrong output path handling.

architectural_recommendations.title: Extend output_validator.py with XLS and DOC binary header checks
architectural_recommendations.rationale: XlsConverter and DocConverter outputs are not covered by existing validators. Validation pass requires non-empty file check at minimum; format-specific header check raises confidence to publishable quality.
architectural_recommendations.action: Add _validate_xls_output() (D0 CF 11 E0 header for binary XLS) and _validate_doc_output() (D0 CF 11 E0 header or 50 4B for docx-in-doc) handlers

architectural_recommendations.title: Implement pair_fixture strategy for Words Merger, Comparer and future multi-input types
architectural_recommendations.rationale: MISSING_PAIR_FIXTURE is the blocker for words_Merger and words_Comparer (both now in Wave 2 allowed_types per denominator). PDF FormImporter and Slides Merger also need multi-input fixtures.
architectural_recommendations.action: Add 'programmatic_pair_input' input_strategy to scenario_planner and fixture_factory, teaching the LLM to create two distinct DOCX files before calling the API

architectural_recommendations.title: Add healing_attempts tracking to example-completion-queue.json entry schema
architectural_recommendations.rationale: Current BACKLOGGED entries have no attempt history. Without attempt tracking, the system cannot enforce backoff, max_attempts, or detect spinning.
architectural_recommendations.action: Add 'healing_attempts: []' field to all BACKLOGGED entries; update queue writer to append attempt records on each rerun

architectural_recommendations.title: Launch email and slides pilots with Phase H fixture strategy design
architectural_recommendations.rationale: Email (1 deferred) and Slides (3 deferred) are blocked at DISCOVERY_ONLY. Both have confirmed LowCode namespaces and denominator files. Pilot launch requires fixture strategy documentation and controlled_pilot_approved=true in family YAML.
architectural_recommendations.action: Design EML/MSG fixture strategy for email; PPTX programmatic fixture strategy for slides; update YAML status to 'active' with controlled_pilot_approved=true

architectural_recommendations.title: Add runtime repair constraint re-injection parity with build repair
architectural_recommendations.rationale: Build repair already re-injects pdf_constraints (REQUIRED/FORBIDDEN). Runtime repair does NOT re-inject constraints. Runtime failures from wrong API usage (missing AddOutput, wrong ResultCollection access) could be fixed with constraint re-injection in the repair prompt.
architectural_recommendations.action: Extend runtime repair loop in runner.py to include pdf_constraint_reminder (same as build repair, lines 784-791) in the runtime repair_prompt

architectural_recommendations.title: Add DOCX/PPTX/EML output format validators to output_validator.py
architectural_recommendations.rationale: Words and Slides output .docx and .pptx files. Currently only xlsx has ZIP-based validation. DOCX and PPTX are also ZIP-based (OOXML) and can be validated with the same zipfile approach checking for 'word/document.xml' and 'ppt/presentation.xml' respectively.
architectural_recommendations.action: Add _validate_docx_output() (ZIP + word/document.xml) and _validate_pptx_output() (ZIP + ppt/presentation.xml) in output_validator.py

architectural_recommendations.title: Track deferred_count snapshot per sprint in release-status.json
architectural_recommendations.rationale: Current release-status.json has no historical burndown data. Without snapshots, healing velocity cannot be computed across sprints.
architectural_recommendations.action: Add 'deferred_snapshot': {'date', 'total_deferred', 'per_family'} array field to release-status.json, appended each sprint

architectural_recommendations.rationale: If deferred_count does not decrease for 2 consecutive sprints, it signals a systemic problem (constraint drift, LLM regression, or wrong wave assignment).
architectural_recommendations.action: Add stagnation_alert logic to completeness_gate.py: if deferred_count_delta == 0 for N=2 sprints, emit HEALING_STAGNANT status in completeness gate result
